picks.title: 'The Hunger Games' Producer Nina Jacobson Talks Using AI to Test ADR Lines Before Recording with Actors
picks.excerpt: Producer Nina Jacobson explains how 'Sunrise on the Reaping' used AI voices in post to audition ADR lines before bringing actors in to record them.
picks.rationale: A major studio tentpole used AI voices only to audition ADR lines in post before the actors recorded them, a specific, copyable workflow that keeps the final performance human.

picks.title: Stage 32 Launches Marketplace To Combat AI Slop
picks.excerpt: The Stage 32 writing platform has launched a vetted marketplace to counter an influx of AI-generated scripts and project submissions.
picks.rationale: A new vetted marketplace launched to filter out AI-generated script submissions changes how writers pitch and how buyers find projects.

picks.title: This FREE AI Previz Tool is Awesome & a Secret Video Model!
picks.excerpt: A free open-source previz tool that locks the exact shot before AI video generation, a fix for stiff 3D-guided AI video, and the anonymous 'Iron Goddess' video model surfacing in Arena blind tests.
picks.rationale: A free open-source previz tool that locks framing before AI video generation is something filmmakers can try right away to get shot control over generative video.

picks.title: China's first fully AI-generated feature film to hit cinemas on Friday
picks.excerpt: Bona Film Group's 'Sanxingdui', China's first fully AI-generated feature to receive a theatrical release permit, opens in cinemas this Friday as a test for the industry.
picks.rationale: The first fully AI-generated feature in China to get a theatrical release permit opens from a major studio (Bona), a box-office test for AI features in the world's second-largest market.

picks.title: 'Nothing Hides on a Cinema Screen': Jo Plaete Talks Brahma AI's Emmy-Winning Face Replacement Tech
picks.excerpt: Brahma AI's co-founder and CTO discusses the Neural Performance face-replacement technology that shared a 2026 Technology & Engineering Emmy with Disney Research, Digital Domain and Rising Sun Pictures.
picks.rationale: The CTO behind Emmy-winning neural face replacement explains what it takes to hold up on a cinema screen, useful technical detail for VFX teams weighing AI face work.
